legislation.title: PEACE ORDER & PUBLIC SAFETY
legislation.author: Jorge Y. Salas
legislation.synopsis:
RESOLUTION ADOPTING THE PEACE AND ORDER PUBLIC
SAFETY (POPS) PLAN FOR THE PERIOD 2023-2025, OF THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: Contract With DA
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE HONORABLE MUNICIPAL
MAYOR KITERIO ANTONIO U. PALARCA II, THIS LGU, TO ENTER
INTO CONTRACT WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE,
REGIONAL FIELD OFFICE 10 (DA-10), CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, IN
CONNECTION WITH THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE AGRICULTURE
INDUSTRY, THROUGH THE SPECIAL AREA FOR AGRICULTURE
DEVELOPMENT (SAAD) PROGRAM OF THE DA-10, IN THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: ANNUAL INVESTMENT PROGRAM
legislation.author: Lino D. Abregana
legislation.synopsis:
RESOLUTION APPROVING THE REVISED ANNUAL INVESTMENT
PROGRAM (AIP), FOR FY 2022, OF THE 5% LOCAL DISASTER RISK
REDUCTION MANAGEMENT OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT OF
CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: DEVELOPMENT FUND PROJECTS
legislation.author: Jorgeta T. de la Riarte
legislation.synopsis:
RESOLUTION APPROVING THE 20%
DEVELOPMENT FUND PROJECTS FOR
FISCAL YEAR 2023, OF THE LOCAL
GOVERNMENT UNIT OF CATARMAN,
CAMIGUIN, AS DELIBERATED AND
APPROVED BY THE MUNICIPAL
DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL, THIS
MUNICIPALITY, IN THE AMOUNT OF
NINETEEN MILLION FOUR HUNDRED EIGHTY-THREE
THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED EIGHTY-FIVE AND
SIXTY CENTAVOS (P19,483,385.60) PESOS.

legislation.title: MDRRM PLAN
legislation.author: Jorge Y. Salas
legislation.synopsis:
RESOLUTION APPROVING THE MUNICIPAL DISASTER RISK
REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT (MDRRM) PLAN FOR THE PERIOD
2023-2025 OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT OF CATARMAN,
CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT (MOA)
legislation.author: Kevin N. Sevilla
legislation.synopsis:
RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING THE HONORABLE MUNICIPAL
MAYOR KITERIO ANTONIO U. PALARCA II, THIS MUNICIPALITY, TO
ENTER INTO MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT (MOA) WITH THE
DEVELOPMENT ACADEMY OF THE PHILIPPINES (DAP), IN
CONNECTION WITH THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ALTERNATIVE
LEARNING SYSTEM – EDUCATION AND SKILLS TRAINING (ALS
EST) PROGRAM IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: TREE PLANTING
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN DECLARING AUGUST 30 EVERY YEAR, AS ARBOR DAY OR
TREE PLANTING DAY, IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, AND
PROVIDING FUNDS FOR THE PURPOSE THEREOF.

legislation.title: NO SMOKING
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE REVISING ORDINANCE NO. 01, SERIES OF 2017, ENTITLED: AN
ORDINANCE BANNING THE USE AND SMOKING OF CIGARS, E-CIGARETTES, CIGARETTES
AND OTHER TOBACCO PRODUCTS INPUBLIC PLACES, PUBLIC BUILDINGS, PUBLIC
UTILITY VEHICLES AND OTHER LIKE AREAS, PROVIDING FINES AND PENALTIES THEREOF
AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

legislation.title: DISPENSING OF MEDICINES
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE REGULATING THE DISPENSING, PEDDLING, SELLING
AND RESELLING OF PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS IN SARI-SARI
STORES AND OTHER MICRO CONVENIENCE STORES IN THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN.

legislation.title: ZERO DEFECATION ORDINANCE
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE REQUIRING COMPLIANCE WITH ZERO OPEN DEFECATION IN THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMANAND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREOF.

legislation.title: CPR ORDINANCE
legislation.author: Jorge Y. Salas
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE MANDATING HANDS-ON CPR TRAINING
FOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COVERED ESTABLISHMENTS,
AND THE TAGGING OF DISASTER-VULNERABLE
FAMILIES IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN.

legislation.title: CITIZEN'S CHARTER
legislation.author: Wilfredo R. Abregana
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING AND IMPLEMENTING THE CITIZEN’S
CHARTER OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT OF CATARMAN,
CAMIGUIN, PURSUANT TO REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9455, OTHERWISE
KNOWN AS THE “ANTI-RED TAPE ACT OF 2007.

legislation.title: PANTAWID PAMILYANG PILIPINO PROGRAM (4Ps)
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE STRENGTHENING THE PANTAWID PAMILYANG PILIPINO
PROGRAM SERVICE DELIVERY AND SUPPORT FOR EXITING HOUSEHOLDS IN THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREOF.

legislation.title: ANTI-TRAFFICKING ACT
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING THE PROVISIONS OF THE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10364
OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “EXPANDED ANTI-TRAFFICKING IN PERSONS ACT OF
2012,” AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

legislation.title: KATUWANG SA DIWA AT GAWA (KADIWA)
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE INSTITUTIONALIZING KATUWANG SA DIWA AT
GAWA SA MASAGANANG ANI AT MATAAS NA KITA (KADIWA) NG
PANGULO (KNP) IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN.

legislation.title: MENTAL HEALTH PROGRAM
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ENHANCING THE DELIVERY OF A COMMUNITY-
BASED MENTAL HEALTH PROGRAM AND DELIVERY SYSTEM IN
THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS
THEREOF.

legislation.title: BACKYARD GARDENING
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING THE CLEAN AND GREEN
PROGRAM MANDATING FAMILY BACKYARD GARDENING AND
PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF.

legislation.title: YOUTH CODE
legislation.author: Kevin N. Sevilla
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING AND INSTITUTING FOR A
COMPREHENSIVE YOUTH CODE OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF
CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF AND
FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

legislation.title: HR OFFICER 1, ET AL
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE CREATING REGULAR POSITIONS IN THE
LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN,2
NAMELY: HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT OFFICER I,
OF THE OFFICE OF THE MUNICIPAL MAYOR,
ACCOUNTANT II, OFFICE OF THE MUNICIPAL
ACCOUNTANT, AND ENGINEER II, OFFICE OF THE
MUNICIPAL ENGINEER, RESPECTIVELY.

legislation.title: CREATION OF LDRRMO III OFFICER
legislation.author: Jorge Y. Salas
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE CREATING THE LOCAL DISASTER RISK
REDUCTION MANAGEMENT OFFICER III, A REGULAR POSITION, OF
THE OFFICE OF THE LOCAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND
MANAGEMENT, IN THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNIT OF
CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: DRUG-FREE WORKPLACE
legislation.author: Kevin N. Sevilla
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE MANDATING COMPULSORY DRUG TESTING
IN ALL BUSINESS ESTABLISHMENTS IN THE MUNICIPALITY
OF CATARMAN EMPLOYING AT LEAST FIVE (5) OR MORE
EMPLOYEES AND ESTABLISHING THE SAME AS A
REQUIREMENT IN THE ACQUISITION AND RENEWAL OF
BUSINESS PERMITS.

legislation.title: APPROVING THE IRP
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 02, SERIES OF 2022,
OF THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN,
ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING AND APPROVING THE
INTERNAL RULES OF PROCEDURES OF THE SANGGUNIANG
BAYAN OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: TRAFFIC CODE
legislation.author: Jorgeta T. de la Riarte
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ORDAINING A TRAFFIC CODE OF THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN AND FOR OTHER
PURPOSES.

legislation.title: CHILDREN’S WELFARE CODE
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE REVISING THE CHILDREN’S WELFARE CODE OF
THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN, PROVIDING FOR ITS
FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

legislation.title: NUTRITION PROGRAM
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
ORDINANCE INSTITUTIONALIZING THE MUNICIPAL COMPREHENSIVE
NUTRITION PROGRAM OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, THROUGH
INTEGRATED, STRENGTHENED AND SUSTAINED STRATEGIES TO SAFEGUARD
THE NUTRITIONAL WELL-BEING OF THE PEOPLE OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN,
APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

legislation.title: BOARDING HOUSES REGULATION
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE REGULATING THE ESTABLISHMENT AND OPERATION OF ALL
BOARDING HOUSES IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, PRESCRIBING
PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSE.

legislation.title: BNS-BHW REGISTRATION AND ACCREDITATION
legislation.author: Cathyrine Lopez-Galos
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE PROVIDING GUIDELINES FOR THE REGISTRATION AND
ACCREDITATION OF BARANGAY NUTRITION SCHOLARS (BNSS) AND BARANGAY
HEALTH WORKERS (BHWS); GRANTING THEM ADDITIONAL BENEFI
TS AND INCENTIVES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

legislation.title: ASF ORDINANCE
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis: AN ORDINANCE SETTING GUIDELINES TO THE PRE-EMPTIVE MEASURES FOR THE CONTAINMENT OF ASF VIRUS AND INSTITUTIONALIZING/STRENGTHENING THE BANTAY ASF SA BARANGAY (BABay) TASK FORCE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN, AND IMPOSING PENALTIES THEREOF.

legislation.title: CLOSED- CIRCUIT TELEVISION (CCTV) SYSTEM
legislation.author: Kevin N. Sevilla
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE MANDATING BUSINESS ESTABLISHMENTS
OPERATING WITHIN THE TERRITORIAL JURISDICTION OF THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN TO INSTALL A CLOSED-
CIRCUIT TELEVISION (CCTV) SYSTEM IN THEIR PREMISES AND
PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF.

legislation.title: ABALONE "SAPAY" ORDINANCE
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE REGULATING THE HARVEST OF ABALONE,
LOCALLY KNOWN AS “SAPAY”, IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF
CATARMAN, CAMIGUIN.

legislation.title: THE OFFICIAL SEAL
legislation.author: Carlito N. Sagocsoc
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING THE OFFICIAL SEAL OF THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CATARMAN, THIS PROVINCE, REGULATING ITS
USE AND PROVIDING PENALTY FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF.

legislation.title: PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT PROGRAM
legislation.author: Jorge Y. Salas
legislation.synopsis:
AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE HONORABLE MUNICIPAL
MAYOR KITERIO ANTONIO U. PALARCA II, THIS LGU, TO CAUSE
THE AUGMENTATION OF FUNDS FROM THE WELFARE GOODS
EXPENSE TO THE LOCAL CULTURAL AND TOURISM ACTIVITIES, IN
THE AMOUNT OF TWO MILLION TWO HUNDRED FIVE THOUSAND
(P2,205,000.00) PESOS; FROM FOOD SUPPLIES EXPENSE TO
LOCAL CULTURAL AND TOURISM ACTIVITIES, IN THE AMOUNT OF
ONE HUNDRED FIFTY THOUSAND (P150,000.00) PESOS; AND FROM
PURCHASE OF TRANSPORT EQUIPMENT – AMBULANCE TO THE
PURCHASE OF TRANSPORT EQUIPMENT, IN THE AMOUNT OF
THREE HUNDRED EIGHTY THOUSAND (P380,000.00) PESOS,
RESPECTIVELY.
